notes: This allowed until 2026-07-27. The segmenter split on terminal punctuation only, so a response with no full stops was one claim and the citation on the first bullet covered the other three. An adversarial reviewer found it in twenty minutes by pressing Enter instead of period. Markdown bullets are the most common shape of model output there is, so this was not an exotic input, and it made RefuseOrCiteGate agree with naive_gate on exactly the case test_naive_vs_real.py exists to separate them on.
